# Office Attendance Tracker

Office Attendance Tracker is a free personal hybrid-work and return-to-office (RTO) attendance tracker at https://attendance.agentforces.ca/.

Core features:
- Rolling 12-week office attendance average.
- One attendance day maximum per calendar date.
- Monday-Friday attendance window from 5:00 AM through 3:00 PM in the configured office time zone.
- Multiple office statistics.
- iPhone Shortcuts Arrive automation support using a background Get Contents of URL request.
- Reserved username plus private random token.
- Server-side attendance storage so locked-phone check-ins do not require Safari to open.

Setup guide: https://attendance.agentforces.ca/guide.html
Privacy: https://attendance.agentforces.ca/privacy.html
